The name has its roots in the biblical tradition, where praise and worship are essential aspects of the Christian faith. In the early Christian church, the name Maelis was likely used to signify a person who was devoted to praising and glorifying God. Historically, the name has been associated with Christian tradition, and its usage can be found in various Christian cultures throughout history.
